text:
sophia: Heads-up: seeing systematic degeneration on long prompts after switching to int4 post-norm quant. Repro attached below, cc @raj @emily

raj: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro & metric diffs?

sophia: quick repro: run eval on long-dialog bench (>=1k tokens) with postnorm-int4 profile. Observed: repetition spikes after ~512 tokens, perplexity +9%, BLEU -6 on our dialogue set. minimal snippet:

```
# calibration
quantize_postnorm(model, backend='int4', per_layer_calib=200, bias_correction='none')
# inference
run_eval(model_quant, dataset='long_dialog')
```

logs: `token_repeat_ratio: 0.42 (fp16:0.12)`

emily: is this the old headwise folding bug or something new in postnorm flow?

sophia: looks like a bias/scale mismatch introduced when we fold pre-attn bias into weights and then apply postnorm quantization. The mean activation shifts layerwise -> small bias accumulates across many tokens, showing up for long contexts. not classic headwise clipping.

jordan: what's the perf cost to fix? can we do a cheap shim instead of re-training/calibration every profile change?

sophia: proposal: per-layer float bias-offset correction computed from a small calibration set and applied at runtime right after dequantize. overhead: one vector add per layer (memory bandwidth tiny). fallback path: disable shim if metric drift or SLO breach.

raj: sounds reasonable. need telemetry for drift. Suggest metric: `postnorm_residual_mean` & `postnorm_residual_std` per layer; if mean > 0.02 or std spikes -> route to FP8 or int8.

sophia: agreed. config sketch for profile enabling shim:

```
"quant_profile": {
  "mode": "int4_postnorm",
  "postnorm_bias_correction": true,
  "calib_samples": 200,
  "correction_store": "per_layer/float32"
}
```

emily: also recommend shadow canary with sampling of 5% requests (no latency on path) to compute real-time quality deltas and automatic rollback triggers. add unit tests for accumulation across tokens.

canary-bot: Canary scheduled: shadow-int4-bias-shim on prod-dedicated at 04/12 06:00 UTC (5% sample)

raj: operational concerns: calibration staleness across model updates and customer overrides. we need lifecycle: recompute correction on model version bump and surface a `correction_age` tag.

sophia: will add `correction_version` + `correction_age_ms` to telemetry and a gating lint that warns if profile enabled but correction missing.

jordan: one more: for small models with narrow layers the residual noise may dominate; add min-layer-energy threshold before applying correction.

sophia: yep — add `apply_if_layer_energy > 1e-3`. ok next steps: sophia -> PR shim + tests, raj -> telemetry metrics + alert rule, emily -> configure shadow canary. ETA: EOW.

emily: thanks, will coordinate with infra for sampling. :thumbsup:

sophia: filing RFC follow-up now with playbook + rollback steps. :eyes:
